title: Phase 2 - Reconnection of the power supply - Create (2)

ancestors.title: Phase 2 - Reconnection of the power supply (2)

storage.value:
User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to create Reconnection of the power supply object

So that I will be able to manage POD reconnection process in flexible and correct way

 

Design: Reconnection_Of_The_Power_Supply (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Creating a Reconnection of the power supply is possible from its listing page by clicking on a 'Plus' button

  2. Clicking on a Plus button will open Reconnection of the power supply's creation page

  3. Check system user permissions to be able to create a new Reconnection of the power supply

    1. For creating such object, user should have any of the permissions listed here:

      1. Create Reconnection of the power supply as a Draft

        1. Allows to create object only as a draft and do not start process

      2. Create Reconnection of the power supply as Execute

        1. Allows to create object and it is possible to start process

    2. Enable Plus button when user has one of the permissions

    3. Disable Plus button when user does not have any of the mentioned permissions

  4. Default state of Reconnection of the power supply object contains fields:

    1. Number

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Empty on creation page

      4. Text field

      5. After creating an object, system should display its number with the following logic:

        1. Reconnection-ID of newly created object (For example, Reconnection-56)

          1. In the given example, Reconnection is hardcoded prefix for number and 56 is ID of an object

    2. Date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Date picker

      4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      5. By default, should set current day of the creation

    3. Status

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Empty on creation page

      4. Two hardcoded values:

        1. Draft

        2. Executed

      5. System should automatically set a value according to the status of the object

        1. If it is a draft should set Draft

        2. If it is saved and executed should be set Executed

    4. Grid operator

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

        1. List is manageable from nomenclature

        2. Active values should be returned from the nomenclature

        3. Order should be considered

        4. Display default if returned from nomenclature

    5. Table

      1. Table should be displayed after selecting a grid operator

      2. In the table should include PODs from Power supply disconnection request(should be with status executed).

      3. Exclude POD’s if they are marked in the Executed Reconnection object.

      4. Exclude PODs if they are marked in executed reconnection object.

      5. Preselect checkboxes for PODs

        1. Preselect POD if All liabilities recorded in the disconnection are paid.

          1. all liabilities for taxes, generated in the previous steps of the process, should also be paid.

        2. should be preselected and can not be deselected

        3. If not paid, do not preselect.

          1. can be selected manually.

      6. Table includes section:

      7. Searching is possible:

        1. All

        2. Customer identifier

        3. Customer number

        4. POD number

        5. Request for disconnection number

      8. Pagination will always appear

        1. Number of records dropdown will have hardcoded values: 25, 50, 100

        2. 25 is selected by default

      9. Checkbox for selecting PODs

        1. Marked and disabled if POD is preselected

        2. Empty and optional if POD is not preselected

      10. Customer

        1. Mandatory

        2. Always disabled

        3. System should automatically display all the respective customer after adding Grid Operator

        4. Customer should be displayed with its identifier and name + legal form in format 5520222522 (COPANY JSC)

        5. Point of delivery

          1. Mandatory

          2. System should automatically display all the PODs for the selected grid operator

          3. Selected by default when

            1. User should have possibility to manually unselect POD and it this case, such POD will not be reconnected

          4. POD should be displayed with its number

        6. Request for disconnection of the power supply

          1. Mandatory

          2. Always disabled

          3. System should automatically display Request for disconnection of the power supply object according to each POD

          4. Object should be displayed with its number

        7. Cancellation reason

          1. Mandatory for selected POSs

          2. Enabled only for selected PODs

          3. List is manageable from nomenclature

            1. Active values should be returned from the nomenclature

            2. Display default if returned from nomenclature

          4. If respective liability for each POD is paid, then should display default value - (For example - Customer Paid)

        8. Date of reconnection (only in Executed object editing)

          1. Optional

          2. Enabled only in Executed object editing

          3. Date picker

          4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

          5. Empty by default

        9. Import button (only in Executed object editing)

          1. When clicked a modal window for import should be opened with two buttons – Import and Cancel

          2. Fields in the modal window:

          3. File for import

            1. Mandatory

            2. When file is selected and user clicks Import button the system should process the file.

            3. fill Date of reconnection for all PODs in the file which matches the listed PODs

            4. IF POD from File does not exist in the list, skip it.

            5. Import file should contains two columns – POD identifier, Reconnection date (in format DD.MM.YYYY)

            6. User should be able to download empty template

            7. If import file format is not correct system should display error as validation error for the field

            8. When import completes successfully the modal window should be closed and all dates should be updated on the main screen

    6. Sub-object:

      1. Template

        1. Optional

        2. It is possible to add more than one template to the object

        3. Clicking on Plus button will open a modal window with single select dropdown, from where it should be possible to choose template

          1. Templates should be displayed with its name

          2. It is possible to search templates with its name

        4. It is possible to download attached template

        5. It is possible to delete selected template from the object by clicking on delete icon

        6. When template is attached to the object, it means system to generate a file according to the template after clicking on 'Save' button and send it to the grid operator at the defined email address from nomenclature (when type is cash payment)

      2. Task

        1. Always empty and disabled on creation page

        2. Will be available on edit/preview modes

        3. Tasks displaying logic / format:

          1. In the task sub-object, a maximum of 10 tasks should be displayed. If the number of tasks exceeds 10, pagination should be shown. If there are 10 or fewer tasks, pagination should not be visible.

          2. Task list logic:

            1. The tasks ordering should be descending by time creation

            2. Also the task format should be changed, we need to have the next format:

              1. Id

                1. Take from task number field - This logic is already added

              2. Display task status

                1. Task status should be taken from task object

                2. In the system we have the next task statuses:

                  1. Open

                  2. In Progress

                  3. Terminated

                  4. Overdue

                  5. Completed

              3. Date in format DD.MM.YYYY

                1. This logic is already added.

              4. Task type

                1. Task type should be taken from task type dropdown - this logic is already added

              5. Example:

                1. 841 - in progress – 26.02.2025 - YOLS-TEST

      3. File

        1. Always Enabled

        2. Optional

        3. Files can be added manually by the user

        4. In this sub-object system should display generated documents according to the Template when user clicks on 'Save' button

        5. Adding file is possible by clicking on a Plus icon

        6. It is possible by the user to upload more than one file

        7. It is possible to preview files when clicking on its name or an arrow

        8. It is possible to delete files – only added manually, generated by the system files cannot be deleted

        9. After adding the file, it should be displayed with file name

        10.  Max size: 50 MB

  5. Save as a draft button

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save as a draft button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new reconnection of the power supply object and display it in the listing page (shouldn't start process until its status is Draft)

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. When object is created as a Draft and it is not executed yes, however, user creates identical Reconnection of the power supply object, should display all PODs

  6. Save and Execute button

    1. Enable is user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save and execute button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new reconnection of the power supply object and display it in the listing page (it is possible to start process)

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. System should generate documents according selected templates and save them in Files

    5. When user executes the object and created another Reconnection of the power supply object for the same grid operator, should display non-reconnected PODs only

  7. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button warning pop-up message should appear: 'Are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close pop-up and user is returned to the listing page

    2. No - will close pop-up and user stays on the current page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings
